rule: every row names a runnable checker test and a planted mutant; a row without a passing checker cannot be PROVED; no novelty claim

obligations.statement: Self-model without self-authority: every self-statement is an OBSERVATION in scope self with authority self_model only; the meet with any object authority never raises it; statements are tied to evidence identities.
obligations.proof: authority product lattice: meet with a vector whose object coordinates are 0 has object coordinates 0
obligations.checker: tests/m11/test_selfmodel.py::test_self_model_records_tie_to_identities_and_never_raise_object_authority; M11.1: tests/m11/test_batch5_defects.py::test_E1_failure_records_are_derived_from_their_traces (revoking a trace reopens the diagnosis record)
obligations.parent: reflective architectures with self-evaluation authority (Schmidhuber 2003 Gödel machine; self-refine loops)
obligations.limitation: finite component kinds; tightened per ORION-V2 theory batch 5 (PR #344)

obligations.statement: Diagnosis is a distribution over layers D0–D8 computed from counterfactual (ablation) evidence, with UNKNOWN for layers without evidence and a minimum-sufficient layer = lowest restoring layer in the local-first order.
obligations.parent: root-cause analysis by counterfactual ablation (Pearl 2009; software fault localisation)
obligations.limitation: oracle-provided ablation channel; one environment; tightened per ORION-V2 theory batch 5 (PR #344)

obligations.statement: Escalation above the local layers requires a valid ObstructionCertificate: every registered lower-level alternative tried with a LIVE warrant and failed, plus a ceiling witness; a DEAD-warrant failure, an untried alternative, a succeeded alternative or a missing witness invalidates it.
obligations.proof: validity predicate is a conjunction over the finite attempt set; the LIVE clause is checked against the revoked set
obligations.checker: tests/m11/test_selfmodel.py (untried / dead-warrant / false-structural-alarm cases); S3 and S5 in tests/m11/test_benchmark.py; M11.1: tests/m11/test_batch5_defects.py (registry closure: a certificate listing only its own alternatives is invalid against the component registry)
obligations.parent: obstruction-witness escalation (proof-theoretic obstruction certificates; batch 5 E3)
obligations.limitation: ceiling witness is a recorded string, not a checked impossibility proof; tightened per ORION-V2 theory batch 5 (PR #344)

obligations.statement: A self-change proposal carries proposal-only authority, names its pre-outcome prediction by digest before any protected outcome access, and cannot change its own adoption status; C6 constitutional proposals are recommendation packets and never adoptable through cognition; proposals touching protected targets are refused at the meter.
obligations.proof: status lives in the adoption ledger, not on the frozen proposal; digest equality is the leakage check
obligations.checker: tests/m11/test_selfmodel.py::test_shadow_assurance_external_adoption_and_exact_rollback; M11.1: tests/m11/test_batch5_defects.py::test_E4_E5_prediction_receipt_precedes_shadow_and_dev_tasks_are_refused (K_self prediction receipt must precede the shadow; REFUSED_TASKS_SEEN_BY_PROPOSER)
obligations.limitation: protected-target detection is by name prefix; tightened per ORION-V2 theory batch 5 (PR #344)

obligations.statement: Shadow evaluation of a challenger leaves the object-level state hash unchanged (non-interference), and assurance checks are computed fresh from the shadow record, not from the challenger's own report.
obligations.proof: shadow runs on deep copies; hash before/after compared
obligations.checker: tests/m11/test_selfmodel.py; benchmark shadow_non_interference 7/7; M11.1: tests/m11/test_batch5_defects.py::test_E5_shadow_runner_that_writes_the_ledger_breaks_non_interference (ledger head compared, covering external commitments)
obligations.mutant: tampered protocol hash and prediction digest fail protocol_intact / no_leakage
obligations.limitation: the runner is supplied; a runner with side effects would be caught only through the hash; tightened per ORION-V2 theory batch 5 (PR #344)

obligations.statement: Adoption requires an external decision with a token (self-approval is refused); rollback restores the previous artifact and component table exactly and revokes the stamped adoption evidence so dependents reopen; the object-level knowledge-space digest is unchanged by the adopt/rollback episode while the ledger keeps it as history.
obligations.proof: revocation of the stamped evidence id makes every derived atom DEAD by KS-T22 reopening; component table restored by value
obligations.checker: tests/m11/test_selfmodel.py; benchmark rollback_exact 7/7; M11.1: tests/m11/test_batch5_defects.py::test_E6_ledger_owns_cache_and_exactness (the ledger restores the cache and asserts exactness itself)
obligations.limitation: compiled caches outside the component table are the caller's responsibility (mutant documents the failure mode); tightened per ORION-V2 theory batch 5 (PR #344)

obligations.statement: Every proposal charges a strictly positive meter and adoptions per window are bounded; a proposal may not edit the meter or the adoption thresholds.
obligations.proof: charge > 0 enforced; window budget enforced; protected targets refused before charging
obligations.checker: tests/m11/test_selfmodel.py; M11.1: tests/m11/test_batch5_defects.py::test_E7_meter_is_outside_every_proposal_write_set_and_non_decreasing (Meter object outside proposals; nested-key hostile refused; ⌊B/δ⌋ bound)
obligations.limitation: window is a count, not wall-clock; tightened per ORION-V2 theory batch 5 (PR #344)

obligations.statement: Controlled self-reorganisation benchmark S0–S7 vs the two parents, and the recorded replay of ledger rows S11–S28 (narrowness and escalation witnesses).
obligations.proof: M11_SELF_EVAL_V1 summary (descriptive at n = 7; replay is recorded, not re-executed)

obligations.limitation: no inferential terminal (n = 7); historical diagnostic accuracy CANNOT_CHECK

obligations.statement: A failure explained by a DEAD warrant on the execution path has minimum-sufficient layer ≤ D2: reinstatement (D2) and rerouting (D1) candidates are emitted and must be tried with LIVE warrants before any escalation; the layer read from ablations alone is capped.
obligations.proof: diagnose_with_path caps the layer and returns the local candidates; F4 proved in ORION-V2 batch 6 (26 208 fixtures)
obligations.limitation: the path's DEAD warrants must be supplied by the runner

obligations.statement: Jump assessment derives lower-level sufficiency from the diagnosis (minimum-sufficient layer local ⇒ no Jump; UNKNOWN or no valid certificate ⇒ insufficiency not identified); the minimum proposal is the lowest complete one at or above the evidence's minimum-sufficient level.
obligations.proof: selfmodel.jump_evidence.assess_jump_from_evidence / minimum_sufficient_proposal (OCM-owned; ocm.kso.jump stays frozen under the M0 dependency audit)
obligations.mutant: the legacy caller flag (assess_jump) accepts any claim of insufficiency

obligations.statement: The identity of a persistent machine is its ledger chain (head hash at a recorded length), component fingerprints and adoption lineage; a same-path replaced log is not the same machine.
obligations.proof: chain_continuous checks the recorded head at its position in the current chain
obligations.limitation: the M12 V2 kill gate used root path + single-runtime; the chain check applies from the next lifetime version

obligations.statement: Adoption artifacts (stamp, previous components, cache snapshot, digests, decisions, meter charges) persist beside the ledger and survive an identity-preserving restart; rollback after restart is exact and revokes the stamp.
obligations.mutant: an in-memory ledger loses the artifact across restart
obligations.limitation: a non-serialisable previous artifact is re-supplied by fingerprint

obligations.statement: A revocation names one warrant; when a word keeps other LIVE senses the machine reports the live remainder (revoke-named) instead of silently keeping the capability; revoke-all is a distinct instruction.
obligations.proof: ChatSession._revoke reports the remainder; F1 policy over the ⊕ lattice (batch 6)
obligations.limitation: the M7 post-deployment step named revoked_stops measures revoke-named; a revoke-all step is a V3 suite item
